title: Trinity DDD Decision Packet
description: Bundle presented to the human operator for a ddd decision. See docs/specs/TRINITY_DDD_HUMAN_GATE_SPEC_V1.md §3. RecordProxy-aligned: presentation pins 9 required sub-fields per §3.1 (Addendum v1.0.1 §E Cognitive Presentation Protocol); verifier_reports[] items propagate capture_refs from the underlying verifier report.

capture_refs.description: Propagated from the verifier_report.capture_refs[] field (TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1 §5). DDD MUST propagate these into presentation.capture_refs[] for operator drill-down.

presentation.description: 3-layer packet from presentation_synthesizer agent. Required fields pinned per TRINITY_DDD_HUMAN_GATE_SPEC_V1 §3.1 (Addendum v1.0.1 §E Cognitive Presentation Protocol).

cognitive_protocol_version.description: Pins to Addendum v1.0.1 §E. Future versions require Addendum (Article XXIX).

summary.description: 1-3 sentence human-readable précis of what is being decided.

convergence.description: Bulleted facts the verifier/planner/executor agreed on. May be empty when no agreement existed.

dissent_flags.description: Bulleted points of disagreement / unresolved tension. Empty array means explicitly 'no dissent flagged' (anti-groupthink).

founder_decisions_required.description: The specific decisions the operator MUST make; each entry is one decision phrased as a question (anti-rubber-stamp).

raw_artifacts_available.description: True if the operator can drill into raw evidence (capture blobs, verifier reports, audit chain slice). False MUST be paired with an explanation in summary.

panel_diversity.description: Describes which roles/models/pyramid-layers contributed to the convergence/dissent (anti-monoculture). distinct_layers >= 2 required on COLD tier (constraint enforced by aggregator).

roles.description: Role names: planner / executor / verifier / human / agent:<name> / tool:<name>

distinct_models.description: Count of distinct LLM models that voted. 0 = deterministic-only verdict (no LLM).

distinct_layers.description: Count of distinct Pyramid of Judgment layers (1-4) that contributed.

synthesizer_not_in_opinion_panel.description: True asserts the presentation_synthesizer agent did NOT vote in the convergence/dissent panel. Required-true on COLD tier per Addendum v1.0.1 §E 'the messenger is not a juror' (anti-synthesis-collapse). Aggregator enforces tier-conditional requirement.

capture_refs.description: ULID list of captures.capture_id rows backing the verifier reports. Subset of the union of verifier_reports[*].capture_refs. Operator can navigate to <session>/CAPTURE/refs/<capture_id>.json to inspect raw evidence (anti-summary-only).
